passage: Welcome to the Greenfield Art and Craft Club! We meet every Thursday evening at the community centre. Our club is for everyone who loves creating things. Last month, we had a workshop on making silver earrings. Our member, Sarah, who is a firefighter during the day, showed us how to design beautiful pieces. She is an extremely talented artist. In December, we are planning a special sale where each individual item made by members will be available. We also have knitting sessions where you can make your own pullover. After our meetings, we often enjoy a break with tea and biscuits, but we ask members to help with the washing-up. It's a friendly and relaxing way to spend an evening. If you're interested, just come along! No experience is needed.
